specs_json.compute: onboard computer with perception stack; fleet-managed via Amazon AMR software

notes: Amazon's first fully autonomous warehouse AMR (unveiled June 2022), designed to lift and move GoCarts (~800-900 lb capacity) while operating safely around people, compliant with ANSI/RIA R15.08. Uses a green safety-projection beam and perception stack to stop for humans, with autonomous docking and charging. Exact battery/compute specs are unpublished; figures are estimates from industry reporting.

failure_modes.name: LiDAR safety scanner occlusion
failure_modes.symptoms: Protective stops, false obstacle fields, reduced fleet throughput
failure_modes.mitigation: Scheduled lens cleaning, dust management, scanner health telemetry

failure_modes.name: Drive wheel slippage on dust/spills
failure_modes.mitigation: Floor cleaning SOPs, traction monitoring, re-localization routines

failure_modes.name: Lift mechanism actuator failure under max GoCart load
failure_modes.symptoms: Failure to engage/raise cart, load cell errors
failure_modes.mitigation: Load-cycle based preventive maintenance, torque monitoring, derate near limit loads

failure_modes.name: Fleet WiFi/roaming dropouts
failure_modes.symptoms: Robot idles awaiting tasking, traffic jams at handoff zones
failure_modes.mitigation: Dense AP coverage with fast roaming, autonomous safe-behavior on link loss

failure_modes.name: Charging contact wear/misdock
failure_modes.symptoms: Failed charge sessions, battery depletion mid-shift
failure_modes.mitigation: Contact inspection/replacement schedule, dock alignment calibration

failure_modes.name: Barcode fiducial misread on worn floor markers
failure_modes.symptoms: Position uncertainty, slow creep mode, task reassignment
failure_modes.mitigation: Floor marker replacement program, SLAM fallback, camera exposure calibration
